items.question: What is the file size of the PDF of the Code of Conduct for Education Professionals in General Education in the UAE?
items.fact: Code of conduct PDF is 227 KB

items.question: What does the UAE Code of Conduct for Education Professionals contain?
items.gold: A set of principles and ethical values aimed at raising awareness and enhancing responsibility of educational sector staff.
items.fact: Code contains principles and ethical values for education staff
